name: Process Explorer
description: Inspect and manage running processes: sort by CPU or memory, inspect details, and terminate processes by PID.
author: VibeShell

actions.name: CPU usage
actions.description: Sort processes by current CPU usage.

actions.name: Memory usage
actions.description: Sort processes by current memory usage.

actions.name: Process detail
actions.description: Show full command line, working directory and start time of one PID.
args: tr "\0" " " < /proc/$1/cmdline; echo; printf "cwd: "; readlink /proc/$1/cwd 2>/dev/null || echo -; printf "exe: "; readlink /proc/$1/exe 2>/dev/null || echo -

actions.name: Terminate process
actions.description: Send SIGTERM to a process by PID.
